profiles.name: Guardian
profiles.description: A nimble warrior specializing in lightsaber combat, using finesse and defensive techniques to overwhelm opponents.
profiles.quote: Through the Force, I am the shield that guards the innocent.

profiles.name: Consular
profiles.description: A Force-focused diplomat who relies on manipulation of the Force and wisdom rather than lightsaber combat.
profiles.quote: The Force flows through all things. Let it guide your path to peace.

profiles.name: Defender
profiles.description: A durable frontline protector who can deflect attacks and shield allies from harm.
profiles.quote: I can't afford to lose this fight! There are people depending on me.

profiles.name: Sentinel
profiles.description: An investigative shadow who hunts down dark side corruption with precision and stealth.
profiles.quote: Darkness cannot hide from those who seek the light.

profiles.name: Diplomat
profiles.description: The ultimate social character, capable of talking their way through any situation with charm and persuasion.
profiles.quote: Words can open doors that even the strongest blade cannot.

profiles.name: Leader
profiles.description: A tactical commander who coordinates allies and inspires greatness on the battlefield.
profiles.quote: Victory belongs to those who fight together as one!

profiles.name: Aristocrat
profiles.description: A wealthy manipulator with extensive resources, connections, and information networks.
profiles.quote: Information is the galaxy's most valuable currency, and I am very wealthy.

profiles.name: Duelist
profiles.description: A social character with surprising melee combat effectiveness using grace and finesse.
profiles.quote: Elegance in both word and blade—a true noble's art.

profiles.name: Guard
profiles.description: A trained soldier responsible for protecting installations, personnel, or assets. Guards provide steady, reliable defensive support and tactical awareness.
profiles.quote: My duty is to protect those who cannot protect themselves.

profiles.name: Scout/Pathfinder
profiles.description: An experienced scout or guide who excels at wilderness survival, tracking, and reconnaissance. Scouts rely on cunning and perception rather than military discipline.
profiles.quote: The wilds are my home; I am never lost.

profiles.name: Laborer/Worker
profiles.description: A common laborer, factory worker, or tradesperson. Workers are skilled in practical tasks and basic survival, forming the foundation of civilian society.
profiles.quote: Honest work is its own reward.

profiles.name: Wolf
profiles.description: A wild wolf or wolf-like creature. Beasts are non-sapient or low-intelligence creatures generated through the Creature Generator system. Wolves are pack hunters with keen senses and natural combat instincts.
profiles.quote: The strength of the pack is the wolf, and the strength of the wolf is the pack.

profiles.name: Bear
profiles.description: A wild bear or bear-like creature. Beasts are non-sapient or low-intelligence creatures generated through the Creature Generator system. Bears are apex predators with immense strength and natural combat prowess.
profiles.quote: The forest yields to those with claw and fang.

profiles.name: Worker
profiles.description: A skilled laborer, mechanic, or technician. Workers are the backbone of galactic civilization, maintaining infrastructure and repairing equipment.
profiles.quote: Honest work, honest pay. That's all I need.

profiles.name: Trooper
profiles.description: A baseline soldier, guard, or militia member. Troopers have basic military training but lack the experience and skill of true heroes.
profiles.quote: Following orders. That's what keeps the galaxy running.

profiles.name: Criminal
profiles.description: A petty thug, gang member, or street criminal. Criminals live on the edge of society, relying on intimidation and violence.
profiles.quote: Credits or your life. Your choice.

profiles.name: Merchant
profiles.description: A trader, shopkeeper, or business professional. Merchants know the value of everything and have connections throughout the commercial sector.
profiles.quote: Everything has a price, my friend. Let's negotiate.

profiles.name: Police Officer
profiles.description: A law enforcement officer, security guard, or constable. Police maintain order and enforce laws in civilized systems.
profiles.quote: By the authority of the law, stand down!

profiles.name: Pistoleer
profiles.description: A precision shooter who deals devastating damage with sneak attacks from the shadows.
profiles.quote: They never see it coming. That's the whole point.

profiles.name: Skill Monkey
profiles.description: A versatile specialist covering social, technical, and infiltration roles with expertise.
profiles.quote: Every problem has a solution. You just need the right skills.

profiles.name: Knuckledragger
profiles.description: An aggressive street fighter who pushes enemies down the condition track with dirty tactics.
profiles.quote: No such thing as a fair fight when survival's on the line.

profiles.name: Outlaw
profiles.description: A charming rogue who uses luck and Force Points strategically to turn the odds in their favor.
profiles.quote: Luck? I make my own luck, friend.

profiles.name: Brigand
profiles.description: A roguish brigand who combines exceptional piloting skills with tactical combat prowess, striking from unexpected angles with deadly precision.
profiles.quote: The galaxy's wealth flows to those bold enough to take it.

profiles.name: Sniper
profiles.description: A long-range precision shooter who operates from concealment with deadly accuracy.
profiles.quote: One shot, one kill. That's all it takes.

profiles.name: Engineer
profiles.description: A skilled technician who specializes in maintenance, repair, and engineering solutions in the field.
profiles.quote: Every problem has a technical solution.

profiles.name: Pistoleer
profiles.description: A skilled rider specializing in hit-and-run tactics from a speeder bike, utilizing dual-weapon mastery.
profiles.quote: Speed and precision - that's all you need.

profiles.name: Survivalist
profiles.description: A wilderness expert who excels at tracking and surviving the harshest conditions.
profiles.quote: The wilderness doesn't forgive mistakes. Neither do I.

profiles.name: Infiltrator
profiles.description: A stealthy infiltrator specializing in reconnaissance and espionage operations.
profiles.quote: The best battles are the ones your enemy never knew you fought.

profiles.name: Rifleman
profiles.description: A straightforward soldier carrying a slugthrower rifle and a big pistol. Perfect for new players learning weapon versatility and the practical Bandolier.
profiles.quote: I've got firepower. Let's see what you've got.

profiles.name: Gunner
profiles.description: A heavy weapons specialist focusing on area suppression and overwhelming firepower.
profiles.quote: More firepower solves most problems.

profiles.name: Brawler
profiles.description: A fearsome Mantellian Savrip brawler wielding natural claws and innate ferocity. Solid walls of muscle and primal power, devastating in close combat.
profiles.quote: Feel the wrath of the claws!

profiles.name: Tank
profiles.description: An armored defender designed to absorb massive amounts of damage and protect allies.
profiles.quote: Behind me, soldier. I'll handle this.

profiles.name: Commando
profiles.description: A specialized commando operative trained for elite strike missions and team-based combat operations.
profiles.quote: With my squad at my side, we can handle anything.
